coverage.description: Displayed radius multiplier, clamped 0–1. Does not affect binning.

gpuAggregation.description: Aggregate on the GPU when supported.

colorAggregation.description: How point weights combine into each hexagon's color value.

elevationAggregation.description: How point weights combine into each hexagon's elevation value.

elevationScale.description: Multiplier applied to all hexagon elevations.

symbologyState.description: Grammar symbology for the hexagon color ramp and geometry property names. A fill-color colorMap becomes colorRange. geometry.position, geometry.colorWeight, and geometry.elevationWeight name record properties; they default to position, and weight 1 when unset.

layers.description: Grammar rendering layers. Each layer is an independent rendering pipeline with optional preprocess transforms and encoding rules.
